goal: Deprecate the encryptwallet RPC to prevent encrypting wallets after creation
Avoids severe footguns where encrypting an existing wallet invalidates earlier backups and risks fund loss
Prevents unexpectedly altering spending conditions on wallets with manually imported descriptors
agreement: Broad concept support with no blocking objections
Concept approval because creating an encrypted wallet upfront and sweeping funds is cleaner (pablomartin4btc)
Concept approval without stated reasons (pseudoramdom, w0xlt, rkrux)
Suggested clarifying GUI scope or deprecating the GUI action alongside the RPC (pablomartin4btc)
Unaddressed style suggestion to remove unnecessary test logging (achow101)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because post-creation encryption leaves plaintext keys on disk and invalidates earlier backups
Encrypting existing wallets can unexpectedly alter spending conditions on imported descriptors
Steers users toward safe upfront encryption when creating wallets
